items.name: Not all angels are in heaven
items.what: Creators fill in the blank 'Not all angels are in heaven... some are [insert personality/job/quirk]' to highlight their role, work, or everyday chaos.

items.name: Taking one for the team
items.what: Creators showcase the specific designated role they always end up playing for their friends, team, or clients.

items.name: Money can’t buy happiness but...
items.what: Creators complete the phrase 'Money can't buy happiness, but it can buy you...' to quickly demonstrate how their product or service boosts mood.
items.format: single clip reel with text overlay

items.name: Fan transition
items.what: Fashion creators lie on the floor in different outfits and use an animated ceiling fan overlay to transition between looks as each blade passes.

items.name: Take that chance
items.what: Creators show quick cuts of their risks, setbacks, and wins set to beat-synced text encouraging viewers to grow and take a chance.

items.name: Fall outfits
items.what: Fashion creators showcase a week of autumn looks through fast cuts while repeating the same simple action in every clip for seamless changes.

items.name: Upside down
items.what: Creators lip-sync and perform hand gestures before executing a smooth transition to reveal a dramatic before-and-after.

items.name: Daily GRWM loading
items.what: Creators start a get-ready-with-me video at 0% loading in loungewear, climbing percentages with each cut until revealing the full look at 100%.

items.name: Getting robbed
items.what: Creators stage a single-shot comedy scene where a bag gets stolen in the background while they remain completely distracted by their phone.

items.name: This is your sign
items.what: Creators use existing B-roll footage and add text pointing at a physical 'sign' to lead into a call to action.

items.name: Age-centered content
items.what: Creators start videos with an age-based hook (e.g. 'things I know at 27') to share advice and insights relatable to their age bracket.

items.name: Once a day, once a week, once a month
items.what: Creators break down their habits, routines, skincare, or posting schedules into daily, weekly, and monthly categories.

items.name: Where are you
items.what: Creators pair a 7-second B-roll clip with a fake iMessage exchange where someone asks where they are, revealing a favorite spot as their true home.
items.format: B-roll reel with fake text exchange

items.name: The process
items.what: Creators reveal the tools, materials, and steps involved in crafting their offering before showing the polished final product.

items.name: AI tipping scene
items.what: Creators feature a product or item inside an AI-generated cinematic scene to make it stand out visually.
